capabilities: Read notes word-by-word in an RSVP view
Highlight the optimal recognition point letter in each word
Strip Markdown formatting like links, callouts, footnotes, and frontmatter before reading
Pause and display fenced code blocks, LaTeX equations, and Markdown tables
Control pace with WPM changes, skipping, and section jumps
extras: The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: Long notes are easy to skim badly and hard to read deeply; the author wanted readers to stay locked on one word at a time and finish notes without losing their place.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read long notes in a focused word-by-word flow, so readers skim badly or lose their place in dense writing.
summary: RSVP speed reading tool that flashes one note word at a time with optimal recognition point highlighting and playback controls.
